query:
SELECT d.id, d."deletedAt" AS "deleted_at!"
            FROM "Document" d
            WHERE d."deletedAt" IS NOT NULL
              AND d."deletedAt" <= $1
              AND (d."deletedAt", d.id) > (COALESCE($2, '-infinity'::timestamp), COALESCE($3, ''))
            ORDER BY d."deletedAt", d.id
            LIMIT $4
